about.bio: Semiso is an Amsterdam-based experimental/electronic artist. He started off his music career producing for smaller artists, but finally debuted with his own single “a_01” on August 31st 2024. Almost a year later, on July 25th 2025, his debut EP “THE PEAR TREE” was released.

discography.title: The Pear Tree
discography.description: THE PEAR TREE is SEMISO's debut EP, where he explores facing a big happening in your life through music. The music sends you through a story of variable stages of acceptance, eventually leading to the ability to move on. THE PEAR TREE is a follow-up to SEMISO's debut single A 01, also featured on the EP as a slightly altered album edition of the song. The EP was recorded over almost an entire year. Starting in August 2024, and eventually getting released in July 2025.
